description: Low-poly bush: overlapping faceted blobs, cut flat at the ground. Pivot at the centre of the base. Piece: bush (foliage_dark). Open at the bottom.

roughness.desc: blob displacement (fraction of the blob radius)

params.code: const m = JSON.parse(detail(0, 'materials') || '{}')[s@material]; if (!m) return; const k = haspointattrib(0, 'tint') ? point(0, 'tint', primpoints(0, @primnum)[0]) || 1 : 1; @Cd = mul(m.baseColor, k);
